caption:
Most owners guess at their response time. This tool scores it.

The Lead Response Audit asks four questions: monthly inbound leads, average job value, how fast you respond, and how (automated or manual).

It hands back three numbers: a response score, an estimate of leads going cold every month, and the revenue that puts at risk.

Industry research is consistent on one point: the faster you respond, the more you close. Run the audit and see exactly where your shop lands.
